registration_timing: After the first extension run failed the exact-zero WLE identity gate and after diagnosing, but before changing the comparator or executing a corrected rerun.

diagnosis.cause: The comparator read the original 17-significant-digit CSV into binary64 but compared it with the corrected run's not-yet-serialized in-memory binary64 values. This asymmetric representation introduced a one-ULP comparison difference even though both persisted CSVs encode values that read back identically.

prospective_correction.comparison_method: Write corrected Person draws with the same %.17g CSV contract used by the original pilot, read the corrected CSV back, then compare the two persisted representations symmetrically.

interpretation_boundary: The failed run remains a failed frozen-gate result. The corrected rerun may pass only under the unchanged exact-zero gate and all other original extension gates. Fit-transition counts from the failed run are not promoted before the corrected rerun completes.
